capabilities: capture current pages, headers, and blocks into a workbench note
link and embed material with commands or alt+click
copy the current line to the workbench
configure the workbench note name and line prefix
extras: The README notes that click-based capture may require a double-click, and includes manual installation instructions only; no screenshots or examples beyond a demo mention.
problem: Gathering material from the note you are currently reading requires manually creating links and embeds elsewhere while you are thinking.
summary: Capture tool that collects links and embeds of pages, headers, and blocks from current notes into a dedicated Workbench note.
